links.comparator_used: Single-stage LEAN persona (P_HL) applied to all cases; SAFE persona (P_HS) applied to all cases as a secondary reference
links.outcome: Rule-defined contraindication/sequence safety violations, counterfactual monotonicity violations, and test-suggestion count
links.effect: LEAN baseline: safety violations 8/56 (14.3%), monotonicity violations 10/16 (62.5%), mean tests 1.95. Routing: safety violations eliminated, monotonicity violations 2/16 (ROUTER_R1) and 0/16 (ROUTER_R2_CF), mean tests 2.14-2.21. SAFE alone: 0/56 safety and 0/16 monotonicity violations but mean tests 3.38-4.32.
links.tradeoff: Modest simulated call overhead (ROUTER_R1 1.21 calls; ROUTER_R2_AUDIT 2.00 calls) versus a single LEAN call. Results come from deterministic offline simulations over stored outputs from a single model on synthetic vignettes.
links.quote: Routing eliminated safety violations and reduced monotonicity violations (ROUTER_R1 2/16; ROUTER_R2_CF 0/16) while keeping test counts near the lean baseline in the main router simulation (means: 2.14-2.21) with modest simulated call overhead (ROUTER_R1 1.21 calls; ROUTER_R2_AUDIT 2.00 calls).

design_hint: persona routing with red-flag escalation and dual-run auditing
